senses.gloss: ch. same, to pick out (of birds, v. P. Sm. 1349); to pick one’s teeth.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 30:17">Targ. Prov. XXX, 17</cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 4:5:4">Y. Ḥall. IV, end, 60ᵇ</cite> <he>מִיחֲצִי שיניי</he> (not <he>ניח׳</he>) to pick my teeth with; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:2:4">Y. Dem. III, 23ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מיחצד</he>, <he>מחצדן</he> (corr. acc.).
